mapper.sql: select l.ledger_id, l.pool_id, l.receipt_id, l.order_id, l.biz_type, l.qty, l.reason, l.operator, l.create_time, p.station_id, p.buyer_id, p.gas_type, s.station_name, b.batch_no from gas_inventory_ledger l left join gas_inventory_pool p on l.pool_id = p.pool_id left join gas_station s on p.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_purchase_receipt r on l.receipt_id = r.receipt_id left join gas_purchase_batch b on r.batch_id = b.batch_id
mapper.insert: insert into gas_inventory_ledger(pool_id, receipt_id, order_id, biz_type, qty, reason, operator, create_time )values( #{poolId}, #{receiptId}, #{orderId}, #{bizType}, #{qty}, #{reason}, #{operator}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select count(1) from gas_inventory_ledger where order_id = #{orderId} and biz_type = #{bizType} for update
select ifnull(sum(case biz_type when 'IN' then qty when 'ADJUST' then qty when 'CONSUME' then -qty else 0 end), 0) from gas_inventory_ledger where pool_id = #{poolId}
